lines.en: label yukispring2:
scene yukirikavisit1
: Hah...Probably. Guess that could’ve gone a little better now that you mention it.
: Technically, it still went probably five times better than I expected it to.
: Yeah, but it still could have gone better.
: I’ll agree that it probably would have been nice to not watch you spit all over the only real friend you’ve got.
scene yukirikavisit2
: Still got you, don’t I? Take it you’re the type who’d want me to spit on him, though.
: Maybe under the right circumstances. But if you were to do that right now, I’d probably just want to take a shower.
: Ya mean you aint already feelin’ grimy as shit watchin’ an addict do what an addict does best?
: What’s that? Relapse?
: Lie.
scene yukirikavisit3
: Kinda funny, actually. How easy that is. But I’ve always wondered if it’s for selfish reasons or just because dealin’ with confrontation kinda sucks.
: It’s selfish no matter what way you look at it when you need to trample over other people’s feelings to get to where you are now.
: Yeah well, they ain’t gonna have to be trampled much longer at this rate.
scene yukirikavisit4
: So...you are using drugs again?
: Maybe. Maybe not. I can say whatever I want and you won’t know what to believe.
: If you are, I’d like to extend my gratitude. I’m very thankful that you’d trust me to be the only one burdened by this knowledge instead of someone who could actually help.
: See, that’s the part you ain’t gettin’. This ain’t the kinda shit other people can help with.
: It’s a constant battle against yourself and even when you think you’re safe, you ain’t. Takes just one thought. One mistake. Then you’re right back where you started.
: And what was that thought this time?
: Was there even a thought at all? Or do you just despise this world for letting you breathe for a change?
scene yukirikavisit5
: What’s it like for you?
: What’s what like for me?
: Hatin’ yourself without a clear-cut reason to do that. Cause you’re in the same fuckin’ boat. Just nobody ever blames you when the ship starts sinkin’.
: Just wanna know if it’d be any easier to forgive myself for any of this shit if there wasn’t such a fuckin’ obvious problem.
: I doubt it, Yuki.
: Yeah...figures.
scene yukirikavisit6
: You know...
: You might be the first guy I’ve ever actually had feelings for.
scene yukirikavisit7
: And you pick now to tell me that?
: Better now than never, right?
: Yuki-
: I ain’t expecting much to come of it. And I already told you I wouldn’t wanna have to drag Sara into any of that shit since she likes you way more than me.
: Just figured...you know. Ain’t worth keepin’ it to myself anymore. And if I’m gonna give you one reason to think about me, might as well keep pilin’ ‘em on.
scene yukirikavisit8
: It’s weird how this shit works, huh? You ain’t my type at all. Feels like I’m rockin’ the cradle a bit too hard.
: So it’s my fault you-
: Pfft. Don’t give yourself that much credit. Just because I think about you sometimes doesn’t mean I’d throw my life away if you don’t look at me enough.
: This happened because I’m weak. None of y’all had shit to do with it.
: Just...
: Some bad decisions catchin’ up to me. That’s all that’s goin’ on here.
scene black
: And on that note, looks like Sara’s had enough time to “cool off.” Place your bets now on whether or not you’ll ever see me around the bar again.
I sigh to myself and move toward the door as Yuki sinks deeper into her couch.
But as I attempt to imagine how the smell of a rotting corpse would blend into the cacophony of other unpleasant aromas in here, I’m hit by a truck.
scene yukirikavisit9
Because this isn’t Sara at all. This is someone I plucked off the street and dragged into a funeral.
: Oh.
: Oh.
: Uhh...
scene yukirikavisit10
: Am I interrupting something here?
: Just the world’s worst intervention. Sup?
: You are naked.
: Not all the way.
: This pleases me.
: ...What?
scene yukirikavisit11
: Nothing. I speak my thoughts out loud when I feel too many things at once sometimes. Please ignore them.
: So that’s where Rin gets it from.
: The fuck are you holdin’? Also, the fuck are you doin’ here? Forget which room is yours?
scene yukirikavisit12
: Oh! No! Uhh...These are...I made...
scene yukirikavisit13
: They’re...Halloween cookies. I just...made too many and figured you might want some of the extras.
: You made these specifically for her, didn’t you?
scene yukirikavisit14
: Shh!
: Heh...Halloween, huh? Figures. You really made those for me?
scene yukirikavisit15
: Yes! I mean...no? Only if you wanted me to make them for you. But the point is that I made cookies and cookies now exist because of me. Please put them in your mouth and be happy.
: Sure. Just leave ‘em on the table and I’ll have ‘em for dinner when I’m not busy destroying everything.
scene yukirikavisit16
: Well, actually...I...
: I was kind of hoping we could...eat them together and like...become friends? If that’s not weird? It’s probably weird.
: It’s just...not really a great time, Rika.
scene yukirikavisit17
: Stop fucking all of my neighbors!
: I’m not fucking either of your neighbors. And you want me to fuck one of them.
: Not this one! I’m trying to be cute and I can’t because you’re over here macking it with my crush! Now, beat it or it’ll have to be a threesome!
: Oh no. Whatever will I do if something like that occurs?
: Can you two stop fuckin’ whispering and just bring the damn cookies over here? I ain’t eaten shit all day.
scene yukirikavisit18
: Coming! Hahah!
scene black
scene yukirikavisit19
The three of us sit down at the table, causing an entire liquor store worth of beer cans to fall over as our legs take their places beneath it.
Rika doesn’t seem to pay any mind to it though, as she’s currently entranced by Yuki for...whatever reason. Probably the “cool” factor.
But I wonder if her feelings would change upon finding out that Yuki isn’t exactly as “cool” as she looks. And I worry that letting Rika fall further might mean having to learn who she really is.
: So, uh...sorry. What’s your name again?
: Rika. I’m Rin’s mom.
: And...who is Rin?
: My daughter. She’s adorable. Do you like Mexican food?
: Uh...sure. It’s fine, I guess.
: We have so much in common.
: Did you really turn a straight girl into a lesbian? Because you’re just as awkward when it comes to flirting as your daughter.
scene yukirikavisit20
: I’m seriously going to kill you!~
: Flirting?
scene yukirikavisit19
: Nope! Not me. Just sharing some sugary treats with neighbors in preparation for everyone’s favorite holiday.
: Not mine. Halloween ain’t exactly full of happy memories for me.
scene yukirikavisit21
: What? Really? How come?
: It’s her daughter’s birthday.
: Shouldn’t that make it even better then?
: Could’ve if I never ran out on her. Now, all it really does is remind me of all the birthdays she had to spend alone.
scene yukirikavisit22
: O...Oh. Well...I’m sure you had your reasons!
: Drugs and Yakuza shit. Mostly drugs.
scene yukirikavisit23
: Yeah. Thanks for the cookies, though.
Update: It did not take very long for Rika to find out who Yuki really is.
: You, uhh...
: Are you still involved in that kind of stuff?
: You ain’t a cop, are you?
scene yukirikavisit24
: Me? No. I’ve actually been arrested before, so...I’m not sure they’d even let me be one if I wanted to. I just...well, you know. That stuff is dangerous. Both of those things.
: The Yakuza’s only dangerous if you get yourself involved with ‘em. They rarely fuck with anyone on the outside.
: Well, yeah. But you are involved with them. And the drugs-
: Is it a hobby of yours to come into people’s apartments and interrogate them?
scene yukirikavisit25
: She just wants to be your friend, Yuki. Rika’s a good person.
: Then she probably shouldn’t be my friend. You saw earlier how well I do with “good people.”
: I was just...I have friends who used to do that stuff too. And one of them runs an NA group in the Urban District. Figured you just...might wanna-
: The one that meets in the old expo center? Or the one that meets in the church?
scene yukirikavisit26
: The church! You already know about it, then?
: Yeah, they don’t like me over there. Granted, I was still probably your age when I last tried going, so shit might’ve changed by now.
: Rika is 42.
scene yukirikavisit27
: What? This girl? Are you fucking kidding me?
: You can call me “Onee-san” if you want. In fact, please do. I insist.
: How the fuck do you look so young if you’re older than me? That ain’t fair.
: I imagine the part where she isn’t a drug addict might have something to do with it.
: I exercise a lot. But also, yeah. I’ve never done any hard drugs. I used to grow pot when I was in my twenties, though. That was fun. And very illegal. Not why I was arrested, though.
scene yukirikavisit28
: But, that said, you don’t look that old. Your skin’s still nice. Maybe a little pale, sure. But you look soft. I want to touch you.
: Don’t.
scene yukirikavisit29
: Honestly, though? I feel like figuring out how to get rid of those dark circles will knock like ten years off the way you look. Maybe some more bleach too. Your hair looks kind of faded.
: First an interrogation, now a makeover? Am I gonna have to find a new apartment or are you gonna learn how to back off a little?
: Hey, you asked this time. I’m just sharing my secrets with you.
: So if you want to share some secrets with me. Like...oh, I don’t know, how likely you are to ever kiss a girl? That’d be cool. Like, I definitely wouldn’t tell anybody. Nope.
: You know what? Why don’t we go back to talkin’ about less personal shit?
: Cause the last fuckin’ thing I need is one more person to let down and you’re gettin’ way too close way too quickly.
: Well, what do you want to talk about instead? Because I figured the Halloween part of the conversation would take up least fifteen minutes and we never even got into that part.
: Beats me. How’d the two of you guys meet anyway?
: He walked in on me while I was wearing nothing but a towel.
scene yukirikavisit30
: And you...became friends?
: I mean, yeah. It’s not like anything sexual happened.
: It wasn’t until a little while later that she grabbed my penis.
scene yukirikavisit31
: I did it to protect my daughter.
: Well, I’m about ready to hit the sack now.
: You don’t have to hit it. Just sorta firmly grasp it and you can get a feel for- oh, you’re tired.
: Can’t really blame her since she was passed out drunk until just before you showed up. If she had it her way, we wouldn’t even be here right now.
: As someone new to the world of alcohol, I’ve found it’s best to stop drinking before you get to that part. So no one can take advantage of you and whatnot.
: Probably best to not say things like that around Yuki.
: Say what? I’m in kind of a trance right now and am only barely conscious of what I’m actually saying. It’s all just words.
: Rika, thanks for the cookies and shit. But I feel like you and I ain’t as...compatible as you might’a thought. So I think it’d be cool if you just left or-
: Can I see your tattoo?
scene yukirikavisit32
: Hah...
: Sorry. It’s just a nice piece and gives me an excuse for my skin to touch your skin.
: Fine. Just make it quick.
scene yukirikavisit33
: Yay!
: I’m surprised you’re even letting her with how annoyed you appear to be getting.
: Feels like a lost puppy wandered into my apartment and now I’ve gotta reluctantly feed it so it won’t fuckin’ die.
: That’s funny because that’s exactly how I’ve felt ever since my partner kicked me out to the curb!
scene yukirikavisit34
: Some of the detail here is really nice. Where’d you get it done? Why didn’t you get it finished? Was it a money thing?
scene yukirikavisit35
: Why you askin’? You got another friend who runs a tattoo shop somewhere?
: Yes, actually. She’s the one who does all of my work. And I could probably get you a good deal if you-
: That ain’t just a regular ass tattoo on my back, you know. It was the start of my horimono. And it ain’t filled in because I bailed on the Yakuza.
: Now, it’s just a big fuckin’ dragon-shaped scar that reminds me of how I let myself get sucked into a life of crime rather than taking over a fuckin’ countryside candy shop.
: You like candy? I like candy. How about you cast aside your disdain for Halloween and we go trick or treating together?
: Jesus Christ, you really are a puppy.
: You’re right. I am loyal and you can pet me as much you want. Additionally, I have a very impressive tongue and I love to lick.
: Oh, I get it now. You turned Rie into a lesbian through persistence.
: Shush.
: I ain’t into chicks, Rika. It ain’t happenin’.
: Can we be friends, though?
: Why? You want to try and “fix” me? All the hints I’ve been droppin’ about who I really am not doin’ enough to push you away? You gonna literally make me drag you outta here?
: If I do want to fix you, is that bad?
: Isn’t the whole point of a friendship or a relationship in general for two people to fill in gaps we can’t figure out how to fill on our own?
: You’re unhappy, aren’t you? Maybe I can help. And maybe you can help me feel a little less alone too.
: Everyone I know already has someone. And so did I until a little while ago. But I do feel kind of lost now. And you’re right next door. So maybe we-
: Beat it.
scene yukirikavisit36
: There’s already one happy-go-lucky girl dead set on makin’ my life all exhausting and shit. I don’t need another one. Even if we do have some shit in common.
: But-
: Beat it.
: I ain’t sayin’ it again.
scene black
: Sorry for...bothering you.
scene yukirikavisit37
: Pretty soon, I’m going to be the only thing you have left to throw away.
: I’m doing her a favor and you know it.
: It’s bad enough that I already pulled Sara into this.
: Is there anything I can do for you, Yuki? Anything that will actually help.
: Just take care of Yumi if some shit ever happens to me, aight?
scene yukirikavisit38
: She needs somebody to look up to. And she’s gonna realize really fuckin’ soon that ain’t ever gonna be me no matter how much she tries to tell herself it will be.
: Are you going to try to get clean again?
: I ain’t ever technically admitted I ain’t.
: You’re right. But I’m also well-versed in hiding the truth from people. And we both know this goes deeper than just drinking.
: I care about you, Yuki.
: I care about you too.
scene black
: It’d be nice if that actually made a difference.
I leave her apartment unsure of whether or not she’ll go to sleep the way she is now or if she’ll find something to help her.
And when I make it home and sit down at my desk, I realize I’m the same way.
Illuminated by the blue glow of my computer monitor, I unzip and unbutton my jeans, then slide them down until they’re in a ring around my ankles.
I cum hard into a bundle of tissues as a silent video plays before me.
They say it feels better than sex.
